function.name: get_availability
function.description: Check available appointment times. Use 'date' for a specific day. Use 'dateRange' for a range like 'March 1 to March 7'. Use 'search' for flexible queries: 'search.findFirst' for 'next available' or 'ASAP', 'search.daysAhead' for 'next week' or 'sometime soon', 'search.daysOfWeek' for patterns like 'any Wednesday'.

date.description: A specific date (e.g., 'tomorrow', 'Monday', 'next Tuesday', 'March 5th'). Use this for single-day queries.

dateRange.description: A date range to search within. Use for requests like 'sometime in March' or 'the first week of March'.

search.description: Flexible search criteria for finding availability.

daysAhead.description: Number of days to search ahead (e.g., 7 for 'next week', 14 for 'next two weeks')

daysOfWeek.description: Days of week to search (0=Sunday, 1=Monday, ..., 6=Saturday). Use for 'any Wednesday' → [3] or 'Tuesday or Thursday' → [2, 4]

timeOfDay.description: Filter by time of day: morning (6am-12pm), afternoon (12pm-5pm), evening (5pm-9pm)

findFirst.description: Set to true for 'next available', 'ASAP', or 'as soon as possible' requests. Returns only the first available slot.

providerName.description: Optional: specific provider the patient wants to see (e.g., 'Dr. Smith')
